name: CausalFunnel Reviews Widget
author: causalfunnel

sections.description:
Reviews Widget For Website – Simple & Elegant Review Management Tool

The Reviews Widget For Website plugin helps you showcase customer reviews and testimonials on your WordPress site with a beautifully designed widget. Easily add, edit, and delete reviews in the dashboard, then display them anywhere using a shortcode.

Key Features

  1. Customizable Review Widget

    • Display user reviews or testimonials in a clean, responsive widget.
    • Show customer feedback in a professional and engaging way.

  2. Easy Review Management

    • Add new reviews directly in the dashboard.
    • Edit or delete reviews anytime with a simple interface.

  3. Shortcode Supportn – Insert your reviews anywhere on the site using a shortcode.

    • Works seamlessly with pages, posts, or custom templates.

  4. Responsive & Lightweight

    • Optimized for speed and mobile-friendly designs.

Use Cases

  • Showcase customer testimonials on landing pages.
  • Add reviews sections to product or service pages.
  • Highlight positive feedback on blogs or portfolio websites.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress repository.
  2. Upload the causalfunnel-reviews-widget/ folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Add your reviews from the plugin dashboard.
  5. Use the shortcode [cf_reviews_widget] to display reviews anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
How do I display reviews on my site?

Use the shortcode [cf_reviews_widget] in any post, page, or widget area. You can also specify the type: [cf_reviews_widget type="google"] or [cf_reviews_widget type="tripadvisor"].

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can change the background color and other settings from the plugin’s admin page.

Is the plugin responsive?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and works on all devices.
